cohort: The study included 11,205 patients who underwent either intracapsular tonsillectomy (ICT) or extracapsular tonsillectomy (ECT) at a tertiary care children's hospital between 2019 and 2024.
finding: Intracapsular tonsillectomy (ICT) resulted in significantly fewer postoperative unplanned healthcare contacts, including phone calls, ED returns, and readmissions, compared to extracapsular tonsillectomy (ECT).
